findings.title: Model Router Call Log Missing

evidence.observation: Model router call log does not exist on disk, preventing verification of model routing health, latency distribution, and failure analysis.

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router process initializes and flushes call logs to the designated path.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into routing decisions, token counts, error rates, and model latency.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: observability_gap; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.95; Risk: medium; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Changes to running services require verification

findings.title: Direct LLM API Invocations in Emergency Alerts

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral with environment API keys rather than querying the centralized model router.

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM requests through the centralized model router service.

findings.expected_benefit: Provides uniform audit logging, fallback management, and latency tracking for emergency alerts.
